factSources.text: Pluto describes deep change, power, control, fear, survival, compulsion, hidden material, and the process of confronting what can no longer stay buried. It shows where life asks for honesty, release, and transformation at the root. Pluto moves very slowly, spending many years in each sign. Its house transits mark long chapters of pressure, excavation, ending, renewal, and the gradual transformation of a life area. Represents a generation with transformative experiences in the realms of innovation, technology, and societal change. This placement can bring transformations in areas related to progress, revolution, and collective consciousness.

eventsDuringTransit.meaning: Imagination meets power. A deep generational signature: intensified collective imagination and transformation. The sextile makes this a natural strength: Heightened collective vision. The growth edge is not to coast on the ease.

Disruption meets power. Upheaval and radical transformation, often tied to social change; quick adaptation to new technology. The trine makes this a natural strength: Fast, effective adaptation to change. The growth edge is not to coast on the ease.
